metadata.description: A collection of simple but powerful Claude Code plugins

plugins.name: claude-md-discovery-extended
plugins.description: Flags CLAUDE.md files that never reached the context window. Claude Code loads a nested CLAUDE.md only when a file tool reaches its directory, so Bash operations bypass it silently; this tracks what was actually loaded and surfaces the gap.

plugins.name: codex-context-loader
plugins.description: Dynamically injects detailed Codex plugin context into sessions only when the Codex plugin is enabled.

plugins.name: adversarial-review
plugins.description: An adversarial code/plan reviewer that uses a Codex-style review contract while reviewing only the exact slice you name.

plugins.name: fix-docstrings
plugins.description: Writes Google-style Python docstrings during development and audits existing docstrings for compliance. A hook injects the continuation-line rule just-in-time when a LangChain tool explicitly enables parse_docstring.

plugins.name: llm-input-engineering
plugins.description: Designs and diagnoses compiled LLM input across prompts, chat templates, tool schemas, structured decoding, prefix caches, retrieval, eviction, and compaction.

plugins.name: using-codex-cli
plugins.description: Execution-verified reference for driving the OpenAI Codex CLI headlessly: codex exec, session resume/fork, non-interactive reviews, JSONL output, sandbox and trust flags, and the stale-flag traps agents fall into.

plugins.name: pyrefly-lsp
plugins.description: Python code intelligence via Pyrefly's language server with deterministic workspace indexing. Needs only uv on PATH — no venv setup, no project-declared dependency.
